summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any repository code. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the formatter entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool after set_alt_screen, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added to tests/test_console.py (test_set_window_title, skips on legacy_windows), tests/test_control.py (test_control_title), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only test_control_set_window_title). Tests and mypy were not run, so the changes are verified only by reading. No commits were made.
